title: story-install skill falsely claims the CLI has no --version flag

description:
## What

`plugin/claude-code/skills/story-install/SKILL.md` instructs the agent to verify
a successful install with:

> Confirm it works by running `story doctor` (or `story --help` — note there is
> no `--version` flag)

The parenthetical is false. The `story` CLI does have a version flag.

## Evidence

- `src/cli.rs:136` documents it in `HELP_TEXT`:
  `-V, --version   Print the installed story version`
- `src/cli.rs:405` parses it: `"-V" | "--version" => Ok(Invocation::Version)`
- The sibling `story-update` skill already uses `story --version` correctly, so
  the two skills contradict each other.

## Extent

Documentation-only defect in one skill body; no runtime behavior is wrong. The
consequence is that an agent following `story-install` will verify with the
wrong command, and `story doctor` is a poor choice for that purpose — it exits 5
with an `AppError::Integrity` whenever the project has any data-integrity
finding, so a healthy *binary* install in a project with pre-existing integrity
issues reads as a failed install.

## Fix

Correct the parenthetical and prefer `story --version` as the post-install
verification. Sweep the other skill bodies and `references/` for the same
claim while fixing.
